warnings: CAMELYON17 uses the supplied center-held-out test split and slide-level 4-class labels, not official challenge patient-level staging.
The existing slide-level validation split shares 27 patients with training. Validation is not patient-independent; the baseline retains the existing split for reproducibility.

training_extension.context: h + sigmoid(Linear(concat(h, mean_neighbor_h))) * Linear(ReLU(Linear(concat(h, mean_neighbor_h)))); hidden width D_inner.
training_extension.initialization: Zero final context layer; zero gate weights and logit(initial_probability) gate bias; preserve baseline initialization RNG.
training_extension.graph: Canonical-coordinate cKDTree kNN, Euclidean input units, exclude self; schema 1.
training_extension.small_bags: min(k, N-1) neighbors; singleton neighbor mean is zero.
training_extension.duplicates: Reject duplicate coordinates rather than invent an ordering.
training_extension.shuffle: Fixed per slide ID and shuffle_seed, assigned in canonical coordinate order.
training_extension.evaluation: Full bags, with the same coordinate mode at training and inference.
